posts.title: Baking Easy-Blog Oven v2.0 with DecafClaw
posts.description: TL;DR : After six years of brooding and Dependabot alert fatigue, I finally rebuilt my blog's static site generator in Go. Easy-Blog Oven v2.0 renders twenty-four years of Markdown into HTML in under three seconds, ditches node_modules entirely, and was built in an afternoon of flow pair-programming with DecafClaw, my homemade agent.
